normalized_actual.title: Install additional fuel filter
normalized_actual.steps: Place a suitable vessel underneath to collect the fuel. Replace left filter (1). Put lever (3) to position (b). Remove filter (1) using an oil filter wrench. Clean sealing face on filter head. Moisten sealing ring of new filter with fuel. Fit SOLAS shielding (→ Page 134). Install new filter and tighten by hand. Turn lever (3) to position (a). Replace right filter (2). Put lever (3) to position (c). Remove filter (2) using an oil filter wrench. Clean sealing face on filter head. Moisten sealing ring of new filter with fuel. Fit SOLAS shielding (→ Page 134). Install new filter and tighten by hand. Turn lever (3) to position (a). Vent additional fuel filter at screw (1). Remove vessel underneath for collecting the fuel.

normalized_actual.title: Change-over of fuel prefilter
normalized_actual.steps: Pull the button on the changeover lever. Turn the changeover lever into the desired position and engage the button. Note: The tip of the changeover lever with the inscription always faces the filter that is in operation. If the tip points downward, both filters are in operation.

normalized_actual.title: Replace contaminated filter
normalized_actual.steps: Read off the vacuum level at the filter output indicated by the red pointer (3). When the red pointer (3) is continuously in the yellow area (B) at the latest, or at a high flow rate moves into the red area (C), switch over to the second filter and clean it. Replace the contaminated filter.

normalized_actual.title: Replace filter element with the engine running
normalized_actual.steps: Operate the engine at low load only. Keep clear of the danger zone of the engine. Components are moving or rotating. Risk of crushing, danger of parts of the body being caught or pulled in! Wear protective gloves and eye protectors/safety mask. Open the screw-coupling slowly. Tank is pressurized. Risk of injury through spraying fuel! Wear goggles or safety mask. Liquid or gaseous media, e.g. fuel, are poisonous. Escaping vapors of highly volatile media, e.g. fuel or ether. Seek medical attention immediately; do not induce vomiting. Do not inhale vapors or smoke. Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses. If contact is made with skin, wash off with water and soap. Keep the engine room well ventilated at all times. Fuels are combustible and explosive. Risk of fire and explosion! Avoid open flames, electrical sparks and ignition sources. Do not smoke. Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses / facial protection. Hot components/surfaces. Risk of burns! Allow the system to cool down to below 50 °C before beginning work. Wear suitable protective equipment/thermal gloves. Avoid unprotected contact with hot surfaces. Damage to component! Severe material damage! For filter replacement with the engine running, operate the engine at low engine load. The filter which is to be replaced must be cut out for a brief period only.

This is NOT a false negative and NOT automatically a true negative - it is excluded from FN/TN scoring entirely (see ExtractionApplicability's docstring). No other entity type is marked NOT_APPLICABLE for this document merely because it was not annotated - absence of a declaration means NOT_ASSESSED, never inferred.
